schema: CREATE TABLE Orders (order_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, customer_id INTEGER, order_date DATE, total_amount DECIMAL, tax_rate DECIMAL, FOREIGN KEY (customer_id) REFERENCES Customers(customer_id)); CREATE TABLE Customers (customer_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, name TEXT, discount_rate DECIMAL);
correct_query: SELECT c.name, o.total_amount FROM Orders o JOIN Customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE o.total_amount * (1 - c.discount_rate) + (o.total_amount * o.tax_rate) > (SELECT total_amount * 2 FROM Orders WHERE tax_rate = 2);
